events.notes: October 31, 2026, 2:00–5:00 p.m. local time. Mega Chandelure makes its Pokémon GO debut in Super Mega Raids; Chandelure caught from these raids already have Mega Level 1 unlocked. Mega Chandelure can reach Super Max Level and, while Mega Evolved, use the additional Charged Attack Ominous Wind+ (50 power in Trainer Battles, with a chance to raise Attack and Defense; 145 power in Gyms/Raids). Its separate, conditional Mega Chandelure boosts run November 2–15 and are tracked in another event. Optional US$4.99 ticket bonuses apply only from 2:00–5:00 p.m. local time October 31.
